auth: WooCommerce REST API (Consumer Key / Consumer Secret) — requires manage_woocommerce capability
prerequisites: Dukkan plugin v1.0.25 or newer (this is the version that introduces the Loyalty Points RESTful routes)
note: Loyalty points settings are stored in the option `dukkan_loyalty_settings`. Per-customer running balances are stored in user meta `_dukkan_loyalty_points`, and every balance change is written to the ledger table `{prefix}dukkan_loyalty_ledger`. Points are awarded when an order reaches 'Completed' and reversed on cancellation/refund.

settings_shape.amount: number — monetary amount that earns points_per_amount
settings_shape.value_per_point: number — monetary value of 1 point at redemption
settings_shape.max_redeem_percent: integer — max % of cart subtotal points can cover (0-100)
settings_shape.excluded_product_ids: array of product IDs excluded from earning
settings_shape.excluded_category_ids: array of product category IDs excluded from earning

update_settings.note: Partial update — only sent keys overwrite. Omitted keys are preserved.

adjust.note: points is a signed integer: positive adds, negative deducts. customer_id is required.

responses.get_settings: settings object (all keys, merged with defaults)
responses.get_ledger: { customer_id, balance, entries: [ { id, order_id, points, type, note, created_at } ] }

errors.when: adjust points is zero or missing
read-only key used on a write endpoint
